title: helianthemum virgatum subsp. maritimum
intro: Helianthemum virgatum subsp. maritimum, commonly known as the Rockrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose have been studied for their potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, with further research needed to confirm their efficacy in various health applications.
